name: Compensation Pipeline - 2023 Road Closures
description:
Tel Aviv Road Closures Compensation Pipeline
    
    Medallion Architecture (Bronze → Silver → Gold):
    - Bronze: Raw data ingestion (CSV + API)
    - Silver: Data cleaning and normalization
    - Gold: Business metrics and compensation calculations
    
    Tables:
    - road_comp_bronze_closures
    - road_comp_bronze_businesses
    - road_comp_silver_closures
    - road_comp_silver_businesses
    - road_comp_gold_annual_compensation (401 businesses)
    - road_comp_gold_street_compensation (44 streets)
    
    Outputs:
    - Total compensation: ₪88.6M for 2023
    - Dashboard: 2023 Road Closures Compensation Dashboard
